from collections import Counter
# Define pair 1 expected and pair 2 as recorded above; identify divider automatically.
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and 0 < c < w-1)
    side = min(sep, w-sep-1)
    left = [row[sep-side:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:sep+1+side] for row in grid]
    lc, rc = Counter(v for row in left for v in row), Counter(v for row in right for v in row)
    shared = set(lc) & set(rc)
    common = max(shared, key=lambda v: lc[v] + rc[v])
    background_case = lc[common] > max((n for v,n in lc.items() if v != common), default=-1) and rc[common] > max((n for v,n in rc.items() if v != common), default=-1)
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(left,right):
        row=[]
        for x,y in zip(a,b):
            if background_case:
                row.append(common if x != common or y != common else 3)
            else:
                row.append(3 if x == common and y == common else common)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if height % 2 == 1 and len(set(grid[height // 2])) == 1:
        split = height // 2
        first, second = grid[:split], grid[split + 1:]
    elif width % 2 == 1 and len({grid[r][width // 2] for r in range(height)}) == 1:
        split = width // 2
        first = [row[:split] for row in grid]

    else:
        raise ValueError("expected a centered uniform divider")

    common = next(iter({v for row in first for v in row} &
                       {v for row in second for v in row}))
    return [
        [3 if a == common and b == common else common for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)]
        for row_a, row_b in zip(first, second)
